title: ZoikoTax release certification manifest
description: ZTAX-QA-001 §31 (QA-REQ-0109 to 0113): a release certification MUST produce a ReleaseCertificationManifest embedding the traceability snapshot and the known-defects/waiver registers as of build time, identifying a rollback/suspension path, and self-hashed for tamper evidence. Built and verified by docs/tools/build_release_manifest.py.

schema_version.description: This schema's own version, not the release's.

version.description: The release version this manifest certifies.

traceability.description: docs/evidence/traceability_summary.json, embedded as-is and not re-derived (QA-REQ-0110). Its own shape is generate_traceability_report.py's to evolve, so it is not locked down further here.

rollback_ref.description: Path or URL to the rollback/suspension procedure for this release (QA-REQ-0112), or null while that procedure does not yet exist.

manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no extra whitespace, UTF-8) of every other field (QA-REQ-0113).
